author: ToHubLab
name: C
short: Cleanup commands with statistics, debug mode and DE/EN toggle.
description: A simple, multilingual cleaner cog for Red-DiscordBot. Counts deleted messages per server, provides cleanup commands (single amount or all), a reset command, statistics, a debug mode that forwards logs to a channel with a 2-second delay, copyright info and a localized help overview. Language can be switched per server with the built-in clang command.
end_user_data_statement: This cog only stores guild-related settings (deleted-message counter, language, debug channel). No user data is stored.
